title: breathtaking — broaden

translations.translation: 令人赞叹的,  壮观的

sentences.sentence: The view from my bedroom window was absolutely breathtaking.
sentences.translation: 我卧室窗外的景色美得令人窒息。

sentences.sentence: an act of breathtaking arrogance
sentences.translation: 令人咋舌的傲慢举动

phrases.translation: n. 针叶树；针叶树针叶树Y

translations.translation: 忠诚的人, 反对独立者

sentences.sentence: Party loyalists responded as they always do, waving flags and carrying placards.
sentences.translation: 党的忠诚支持者们一如既往地以挥舞旗帜和高举海报作为回应。

sentences.sentence: They went to the mosque to pray.
sentences.translation: 他们去清真寺祷告。

phrases.translation: 质量检验；进货检查；受入检查
收文；进入讯息；输入报文
进料品质管制人员（略作IQC）

sentences.sentence: When others check in their code, you will see it as incoming to your workspace.
sentences.translation: 当其他人核查他们的代码时，您将看到它像引入您的工作空间一样。

sentences.sentence: Reject no incoming request, regardless of the impact they may have on service level agreements.
sentences.translation: 不拒绝任何传入的请求，不管它们会对服务水平协议产生什么影响。

sentences.sentence: You can see how using this mechanism enables you to influence the behavior of the ESB, and how it handles incoming requests based on policy definitions you store in the registry.
sentences.translation: 您可以看到使用此机制如何使您能够影响 ESB 的行为，以及它如何基于您存储在注册中心的策略定义对传入请求进行处理。

translations.translation: 不可预见地,  不能预料地

sentences.sentence: Because the cave fish may not need less sleep—they may need to stay awake to forage more in an environment where food can be scarce and appear unpredictably.
sentences.translation: 因为穴居鱼可能并不需要睡得更少——它们可能需要保持清醒，以便更经常地在食物短缺和食物不常出现的环境中觅食。

sentences.sentence: I can't bear the sound of chalk scraping on a blackboard.
sentences.translation: 我忍受不了粉笔在黑板上的刮擦声。

sentences.sentence: Elephants and other animals could walk freely without scraping their head on the ceiling -- with plenty of room to spare.
sentences.translation: 大象和其他动物可以自由走动而不让天花板刮到它们的头部——那里有着充足的备用空间。

sentences.sentence: Or, like me, you can go back and forth, alternatively scraping off the accumulated gunk and making yourself more accessible by taking on more of it.
sentences.translation: 或者像我一样，你可以后退或者前进，抑或是刮去那堆堆积物，通过呈现更多使你自己变得更加容易接近。

sentences.sentence: Our office is being completely reorganized.
sentences.translation: 我们办公室正在彻底改组。

translations.translation: 土耳其语(的), 土耳其语系者(的)
不成熟的, 未完全发展的

sentences.sentence: He forgave his son’s immature behaviour.
sentences.translation: 他原谅了儿子的幼稚行为。

phrases.translation: 加工精度；精加工精确度
精度控制；精确控制，精确度控制
精度检验，精度试验；准确度测试
动态精度；动态正确性；动态准确度

sentences.sentence: He passes the ball with unerring accuracy.
sentences.translation: 他传球准确无误。

sentences.sentence: She was momentarily lost for words.
sentences.translation: 她一时语塞。

sentences.sentence: Jimmy paused momentarily.
sentences.translation: 吉米停顿了片刻。

translations.translation: 自负的, 过于自信的

sentences.sentence: God warns us never to get cocky and overconfident; that is the recipe for disaster.
sentences.translation: 神警告我们绝不可自高过于自信，那是招致灾难的处方。

sentences.sentence: Islamists should be careful not to fall into the trap of feeling overconfident: they must accommodate other trends, even if it means making painful concessions.
sentences.translation: 伊斯兰教徒要小心地避开可能陷入的自负的陷阱：他们必须适应潮流，即使这意味着他们必须做出痛苦的让步。

sentences.sentence: I will always remember Brittany as that loud, overconfident girl, and a part of that shy, insecure person I used to be will always keep me humble.
sentences.translation: 我会一直记住布里塔尼，那个举止招摇而又张狂自负的女孩。 而曾经腼腆而又不自信的我也会一如既往地保持那份谦卑。

phrases.translation: 为…而费心，为…操心；用…打扰

sentences.sentence: Danny, don’t bother Ellen while she’s reading.
sentences.translation: 丹尼，埃伦看书的时候不要去打扰她 。

sentences.sentence: Would it bother you if I put on some music?
sentences.translation: 我放点音乐会你介意吗？

translations.translation: 老板, 上司 vt指挥

phrases.translation: 雨果·波士（德国著名服装品牌）

sentences.translation: 我得向老板请一天假。

sentences.sentence: Since I’m my own boss (=  I work for myself, rather than for an employer  ) , my hours are flexible.
sentences.translation: 我自己当老板，所以我的时间很灵活。

sentences.sentence: They cover him quickly as the crowbar clangs to the ground.
sentences.translation: 他们迅速掩盖了洞口，撬棍当啷一声，落在了地上。

sentences.sentence: I pried it loose with a crowbar and hoisted it into the wheelbarrow.
sentences.translation: 我用撬棍把它撬松，然后搬到了手推车里。

sentences.sentence: I was holding a large crowbar, and my co-worker was holding a sledgehammer.
sentences.translation: 我拿着一根很大的撬棍，我的同事拿着一把大锤。

sentences.sentence: ...the interdependence of nations.
sentences.translation: …国家间的相互依赖。

phrases.translation: 地震震级，地震等级；地震规模

sentences.sentence: An operation of this magnitude is going to be difficult.
sentences.translation: 一个这么大的手术会很难的。

translations.translation: 放宽, 变宽, 扩大, 加宽

sentences.sentence: Mr Mates said the party must broaden its appeal to younger voters.
sentences.translation: 梅茨先生说该党必须扩大在年轻选民中的影响。

sentences.sentence: Flynn’s appeal broadened as the campaign continued into the summer months.
sentences.translation: 随着这场运动持续到夏季，弗林的号召力也扩大了。

sentences.sentence: I want to broaden the discussion to other aspects of the problem.
sentences.translation: 我想将讨论范围扩展到这个问题的其他方面。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 333 单元

breathtaking
音标：英 /'breθteɪkɪŋ/  美 /'brɛθtekɪŋ/
adj. 令人赞叹的,  壮观的
例句：The view from my bedroom window was absolutely breathtaking.
我卧室窗外的景色美得令人窒息。
例句：an act of breathtaking arrogance
令人咋舌的傲慢举动

coniferous
音标：英 /kəʊ'nɪfərəs/  美 /ko'nɪfərəs/
adj. 松类的,  结球果的
短语：coniferous forest — 针叶林；原始森林
短语：coniferous tree — n. 针叶树；针叶树针叶树Y

loyalist
音标：英 /'lɒɪəlɪst/  美 /'lɔɪəlɪst/
n. 忠诚的人, 反对独立者
例句：Party loyalists responded as they always do, waving flags and carrying placards.
党的忠诚支持者们一如既往地以挥舞旗帜和高举海报作为回应。

pray
音标：英 /preɪ/  美 /pre/
v. 祈祷, 恳求
短语：pray for — 恳求，请求
例句：They went to the mosque to pray.
他们去清真寺祷告。

incoming
音标：英 /'ɪnkʌmɪŋ/  美 /'ɪnkʌmɪŋ/
adj. 引入的
短语：incoming inspection — 质量检验；进货检查；受入检查
短语：incoming call — 来电；呼入
短语：incoming data — 输入数据，引入数据
短语：incoming message — 收文；进入讯息；输入报文
短语：incoming flow — 来流
短语：incoming quality control — 进料品质管制人员（略作IQC）
例句：When others check in their code, you will see it as incoming to your workspace.
当其他人核查他们的代码时，您将看到它像引入您的工作空间一样。
例句：Reject no incoming request, regardless of the impact they may have on service level agreements.
不拒绝任何传入的请求，不管它们会对服务水平协议产生什么影响。
例句：You can see how using this mechanism enables you to influence the behavior of the ESB, and how it handles incoming requests based on policy definitions you store in the registry.
您可以看到使用此机制如何使您能够影响 ESB 的行为，以及它如何基于您存储在注册中心的策略定义对传入请求进行处理。

unpredictably
音标：英 /ˌʌnprɪˈdɪktəblɪ/  美 /ˌʌnprɪˈdɪktəblɪ/
adv. 不可预见地,  不能预料地
例句：Because the cave fish may not need less sleep—they may need to stay awake to forage more in an environment where food can be scarce and appear unpredictably.
因为穴居鱼可能并不需要睡得更少——它们可能需要保持清醒，以便更经常地在食物短缺和食物不常出现的环境中觅食。

scraping
音标：英 /'skreɪpɪŋ/  美 /'skrepɪŋ/
v&n. 刮，擦
短语：scrape together — 东拼西凑
短语：scrape up — vt. 积攒；积蓄；凑集
短语：scrape off — 刮掉；擦去
短语：scrape along — 勉强糊口
短语：scrape through — 勉强通过
例句：I can't bear the sound of chalk scraping on a blackboard.
我忍受不了粉笔在黑板上的刮擦声。
例句：Elephants and other animals could walk freely without scraping their head on the ceiling -- with plenty of room to spare.
大象和其他动物可以自由走动而不让天花板刮到它们的头部——那里有着充足的备用空间。
例句：Or, like me, you can go back and forth, alternatively scraping off the accumulated gunk and making yourself more accessible by taking on more of it.
或者像我一样，你可以后退或者前进，抑或是刮去那堆堆积物，通过呈现更多使你自己变得更加容易接近。

reorganize
音标：英 /,ri:'ɔ:ɡənaiz/  美 /rɪ'ɔrgə'naɪz/
v. 改组, 整顿
例句：Our office is being completely reorganized.
我们办公室正在彻底改组。

Turkic
音标：英 /'tə:kik/  美 /'tə:kik/
n. 土耳其语(的), 土耳其语系者(的)

immature
音标：英 /,ɪmə'tjʊə; ,ɪmə'tjɔː/  美 /,ɪmə'tʃʊr/
adj. 不成熟的, 未完全发展的
例句：He forgave his son’s immature behaviour.
他原谅了儿子的幼稚行为。

accuracy
音标：英 /'ækjʊrəsɪ/  美 /'ækjərəsi/
n. 精确性, 正确度
短语：high accuracy — 高准确度
短语：measurement accuracy — 量测精度
短语：measuring accuracy — 测量精度；计量精度
短语：machining accuracy — 加工精度；精加工精确度
短语：control accuracy — 控制精度
短语：positioning accuracy — 定位精度；定位准确度
短语：calculation accuracy — 计算精度
短语：tracking accuracy — 跟踪精度
短语：degree of accuracy — 精确度
短语：accuracy of measurement — 测量精度
短语：dimensional accuracy — 尺寸精度
短语：location accuracy — 定位精度；定位准确度
短语：accuracy control — 精度控制；精确控制，精确度控制
短语：accuracy test — 精度检验，精度试验；准确度测试
短语：calibration accuracy — 校准精度；校准精确度
短语：accuracy of measuring — 计量准确度
短语：dynamic accuracy — 动态精度；动态正确性；动态准确度
短语：alignment accuracy — 对准精度；调整精度
短语：relative accuracy — 相对精度
短语：accuracy grade — 精度等级；准确度级别
例句：He passes the ball with unerring accuracy.
他传球准确无误。

momentarily
音标：英 /'məʊm(ə)nt(ə)rɪlɪ; ,məʊm(ə)n'terɪlɪ/  美 /,momən'tɛrəli/
adv. 暂时地, 立刻地
例句：She was momentarily lost for words.
她一时语塞。
例句：Jimmy paused momentarily.
吉米停顿了片刻。

overconfident
音标：英 /əʊvə'kɒnfɪd(ə)nt/
adj. 自负的, 过于自信的
例句：God warns us never to get cocky and overconfident; that is the recipe for disaster.
神警告我们绝不可自高过于自信，那是招致灾难的处方。
例句：Islamists should be careful not to fall into the trap of feeling overconfident: they must accommodate other trends, even if it means making painful concessions.
伊斯兰教徒要小心地避开可能陷入的自负的陷阱：他们必须适应潮流，即使这意味着他们必须做出痛苦的让步。
例句：I will always remember Brittany as that loud, overconfident girl, and a part of that shy, insecure person I used to be will always keep me humble.
我会一直记住布里塔尼，那个举止招摇而又张狂自负的女孩。 而曾经腼腆而又不自信的我也会一如既往地保持那份谦卑。

expansionist
音标：美 /ɪk'spænʃənɪst/
n&a. 扩张主义(的)

bother
音标：英 /'bɒðə/  美 /'bɑðɚ/
v&n. 烦扰, 打扰 v
短语：don't bother — 不用麻烦了；不打扰了
短语：bother about — 烦恼
短语：bother with — 为…而费心，为…操心；用…打扰
短语：can't be bothered — 不想出力，不愿找麻烦
短语：bother to do sth — 费心去做某事
例句：Danny, don’t bother Ellen while she’s reading.
丹尼，埃伦看书的时候不要去打扰她 。
例句：Would it bother you if I put on some music?
我放点音乐会你介意吗？

boss
音标：英 /bɒs/  美 /bɑs/
n. 老板, 上司 vt指挥
短语：gang boss — 小组长；领班；帮派头目
短语：party boss — 党魁
短语：lug boss — 突起部，凸起部
短语：wheel boss — 轮毂，轮心
短语：hugo boss — 雨果·波士（德国著名服装品牌）
例句：I’ll have to ask my boss for a day off.
我得向老板请一天假。
例句：Since I’m my own boss (=  I work for myself, rather than for an employer  ) , my hours are flexible.
我自己当老板，所以我的时间很灵活。

crowbar
音标：英 /'krəʊbɑː/  美 /'krobɑr/
n. 撬棍, 铁橇
例句：They cover him quickly as the crowbar clangs to the ground.
他们迅速掩盖了洞口，撬棍当啷一声，落在了地上。
例句：I pried it loose with a crowbar and hoisted it into the wheelbarrow.
我用撬棍把它撬松，然后搬到了手推车里。
例句：I was holding a large crowbar, and my co-worker was holding a sledgehammer.
我拿着一根很大的撬棍，我的同事拿着一把大锤。

interdependence
音标：英 /,ɪntədɪ'pendəns/  美 /,ɪntɚdɪ'pɛndəns/
n. 互相依赖
例句：...the interdependence of nations.
…国家间的相互依赖。

magnitude
音标：英 /'mægnɪtjuːd/  美 /'mæɡnɪtud/
n. 大小, 数量,量级
短语：order of magnitude — 数量级
短语：earthquake magnitude — 地震震级，地震等级；地震规模
短语：absolute magnitude — 绝对星等；绝对量级
短语：signal magnitude — 信号幅度
例句：An operation of this magnitude is going to be difficult.
一个这么大的手术会很难的。

broaden
音标：英 /'brɔːd(ə)n/  美 /'brɔdn/
v. 放宽, 变宽, 扩大, 加宽
例句：Mr Mates said the party must broaden its appeal to younger voters.
梅茨先生说该党必须扩大在年轻选民中的影响。
例句：Flynn’s appeal broadened as the campaign continued into the summer months.
随着这场运动持续到夏季，弗林的号召力也扩大了。
例句：I want to broaden the discussion to other aspects of the problem.
我想将讨论范围扩展到这个问题的其他方面。
